statements.subject: session
statements.description: UID command with COPY, MOVE, FETCH, or STORE arguments using unique identifiers instead of message sequence numbers; a non-existent unique identifier is ignored without error. Result: OK - UID command completed; NO - UID command error; BAD - command unknown or arguments invalid.
statements.trigger: UID COPY | UID MOVE | UID FETCH | UID STORE
actions: process command using UIDs instead of sequence numbers

statements.subject: session
statements.description: UID EXPUNGE command permanently removes all messages that have both the \Deleted flag set and a UID included in the specified sequence set from the currently selected mailbox.
statements.post_cond: message.flag = \Deleted & message.uid IN sequence_set => message.permanently_removed = true

statements.subject: session
statements.description: UID SEARCH command returns unique identifiers instead of message sequence numbers in the ESEARCH response; the corresponding ESEARCH response MUST include the UID indicator.
actions: send untagged ESEARCH response with UID indicator and UIDs

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Server implementations MUST implicitly include the UID message data item as part of any FETCH response caused by a UID command, regardless of whether a UID was specified as a message data item to the FETCH.
